tp.communication: RowParallelLinear末尾All-Reduce(SUM)，两端都得到完整Y；先前中间特征保持分片，没有为了示例额外All-Gather。

dp.communication: 两个DP副本分别持有完整相同权重，各自处理不同请求；此dense前向没有跨DP的hidden拼接或All-Reduce。
dp.independenceCheck: 拼接输入后的逐行输出等于独立输出拼接，仅用于离线验算，不是DP执行步骤。

real_vllm_boundary_notes: 非首Worker先收元数据，再分配接收buffer并提交tensor irecv；AsyncIntermediateTensors在消费前等待完成。
Qwen2实际中间对象携带hidden_states与residual；此处数值教学算子省略residual，不能凭空将它设零冒充真实值。
模型return→Runner return→本地Worker，只返回对象；isend_tensor_dict才提交跨rank发送。
末stage返回hidden之后，真实Runner另行选择logits_indices并compute_logits，再采样；本数值实例终止于hidden。
跨stage数据传输保持矩阵数值与token行序不变；下一stage计算才改变数值。

validation.method: Python standard library fractions.Fraction; hand-written expected matrices; independent row-wise oracle
assertions: EP: each routed token has exactly 2 choices with weights summing to 1
EP: all four dispatch matrices, pre-ReLU matrices and expert output matrices equal handwritten expectations
EP: exactly 8 logical token-expert items, 4 cross-rank items; expert ownership is E0/E1→R0, E2/E3→R1
EP: weighted contributions and source-order combined matrix equal handwritten Fraction expectations
EP: combined result equals independent direct weighted-expert oracle without dispatch ordering
PP: each pre-ReLU/output matrix equals handwritten expectations
PP: every transfer preserves values and row order; receiver input equals previous stage output
PP: final hidden equals independent serial row-wise result [[15,3],[8,0]]
validation.limits: Arithmetic and source-semantics validation only. No benchmark, model execution, GPU/NPU transfer, HTML or browser validation.

spcp.computation: Python float64; full_precision is authoritative; display rounds numerical matrices to 4 decimal places. Format numbers with toFixed(4) if trailing zeros are required.

sp.title: SP: token shard → All-Gather → real TP causal attention → Reduce-Scatter
sp.scope: A minimal two-head attention + output projection, not a complete DeepSeek layer. Norm, residual and MLP are omitted. X has four tokens, two hidden columns; each attention head has dimension one. Q=K=V=X by identity projection; causal attention; scale=1/sqrt(1)=1. Wo rows belong to the corresponding head/rank.

steps.description: rank0 owns tokens 0,1; rank1 owns tokens 2,3. Each token row retains both hidden columns.
Both ranks receive the full X, [4,2]. This is concatenation, not SUM.

steps.operation: Local head projection and causal attention
steps.description: rank0 computes Q/K/V from column 0 and head0; rank1 uses column 1 and head1. Each head attends to tokens at or before the query token; masked score entries are null and masked probabilities are zero.
A_r = head_output_r @ Wo_row_r. Both A0 and A1 are [4,2] partial sums computed from real attention; they are not fabricated attention outputs.
Y=A0+A1. The collective sums contributions and returns rows 0,1 to rank0 and rows 2,3 to rank1. Y shown in the diagram is the mathematical full result, not a required intermediate all-reduce.
Concatenate the two output token shards and compare with unsharded concat(head0,head1) @ Wo.

cp.title: DCP: KV-token shards → local softmax O/LSE → LSE correction → head Reduce-Scatter → current-token merge
cp.scope: FlashAttention DCP AG+RS combine path. One decode query token, four history tokens, two Q heads and one shared GQA KV head, head_dim=2. Global Q/K/V values are illustrative but all attention/merge values are calculated. Historical tokens use interleave size 1: rank0 tokens 0,2; rank1 tokens 1,3. Current token is token4. The singleton query-token dimension is omitted from displayed matrices.
cp.exact_Q_definition: Q_head0=[sqrt(2),0], Q_head1=[0,sqrt(2)]; scale=1/sqrt(2), so history scores are exactly [1,0,2,0] and [0,1,0,2] in mathematical real arithmetic.

steps.operation: Own Q heads and historical KV-token shards
steps.description: rank0 initially has Q head0 and KV for history tokens 0,2; rank1 has Q head1 and KV for tokens 1,3. KV head count stays one; context is sharded by token positions.
Each rank obtains both Q heads, shape [1,2,2], to query its own history shard.
For each Q head calculate local scores QK^T/sqrt(2), local softmax, normalized local O and local natural-log LSE. Local O values cannot be directly averaged or summed.

steps.operation: All-Gather LSE and reweight local O
steps.description: L_hist[h]=logsumexp(L_0[h],L_1[h]); alpha_r[h]=exp(L_r[h]-L_hist[h]); C_r[h]=alpha_r[h]*O_r[h]. This needs gathered LSE, not a full historical-KV gather.

Mathematically O_hist=C0+C1. One reduce-scatter performs this SUM and returns head0 to rank0, head1 to rank1. The full summed O in JSON is explanatory; do not draw an extra SUM communication followed by another RS reduction. Each rank also selects its matching global LSE head slice.

steps.operation: Current-token attention on each local Q head
steps.description: Current token K=[1,1], V=[2,2] is available to each local Q head through the replicated single KV head. With one key, current O=V and LSE=its score=1. Historical context excludes this token, so it is not double-counted.

steps.operation: Merge history and current token states
steps.description: L_final=logaddexp(L_hist,L_cur); O_final=exp(L_hist-L_final)*O_hist + exp(L_cur-L_final)*O_cur. Each rank merges its own head locally. This merge combines attention states; it is not a KV-buffer concat or a second cross-rank reduction.
Compare final per-head outputs against one softmax over all five tokens [history0..3,current4]. Verify history-only combine separately against four-token full attention.
